cohort: The study included 292 mothers with their up to 6-month-old babies who were inpatients of the pediatric department at Chandka Medical College Hospital, Larkana, Pakistan.
finding: Out of 292 infants, 60.3% were not exclusively breastfed, with perceived insufficient milk (60.2%) and mothers having to work (15.9%) being primary reasons.
mod_finding: The study mentioned 'mode of delivery' as a collected variable but did not report any specific findings related to it.
